chunks: From him, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) passed by a young woman who had bought meat from a butcher while she was saying 'Increase [the price/amount] for me.' So the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said, 'Increase for her, for it is greater for blessing.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) say about increasing the amount in trade for blessing?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs a butcher to increase the portion or price for a young woman, linking commercial generosity directly to divine blessing (*barakah*). This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on *ihsan* (excellence) in trade, where fair and generous dealings are not merely social courtesies but spiritual acts that invite sustenance. The hadith serves as a practical guideline for merchants to prioritize customer welfare as a means of securing spiritual and material prosperity.
